svg.title: foreman
svg.desc: Pixel-art night building site: the foreman in a white hard hat holds the plan and sends dashed orders to a crew of pixel agents on the floors of a building. Each agent shows its board stage: running, verifying, waiting with a needs-decision balloon, done in the lounge. A crane lowers a beam onto the top floor.
